The file holds the delays of a hover open and close for the store of Base UI. `PreviewCard.Trigger` has the defaults `600` and `300` of its `delay` and `closeDelay` props.

`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the root through the parts: the open state with each reason, `v-model:open` and `v-model:trigger-id`, `cancel()`, the `close()` of a template ref, the hover open and close with their delays, a card that no hover opened, the dismissal, nested cards, `data-instant` and the server render. The parts render no transition status and no unmount action: `<Transition>` animates the popup, and its JavaScript hooks replace `unmount()`, `preventUnmountOnClose()` and `openChangeComplete`.

`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the handle and more links: links outside the root, `open(id)`, `close()`, `isOpen`, the payload of each link, a root before its links, the move to another link with no delay at a hover and at a focus, the open with no delay while the card leaves, and the close when the active link leaves the DOM.

`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the link: its element and attributes with no ARIA attribute, the hover and focus delays, no open for a touch, the triangle to the card, the focus at the return to the window, and the error with no root.
`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the popup: its element and `tabindex`, its content, the close by hover, and the errors with no root and no positioner. The popup has no transition status.

`line.test.ts` tests the place of the card at the line of a wrapped link that the pointer was on: after the delay, while open, after a scroll, for a link of two parts, with a virtual anchor, with `positionMethod="fixed"`, and the side rectangle after an open by the focus or the parent. `PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the error with no portal. The placement props are those of the popup layer, which `Popover.test.ts` tests.
`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the portal: `keepMounted`, a container in `to`, `to` of `null` and `disabled`. The portal renders no element of its own, so it has no `render` slot.
`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the backdrop: its element, `pointer-events: none`, and `hidden` and `inert` with `keepMounted`.
`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the arrow: its element, `aria-hidden` and the attributes of its side.
`PreviewCard.test.ts` tests the viewport: `data-instant`, the id of the active link in its slot, and the error with no positioner.
`PreviewCard.spec.ts` tests the types of the payload through the root, the link and the handle, the details, the props of the positioner, and the element of a template ref.

`@after-enter` and `@after-leave` of a `<Transition>` around the popup run after its animations, so the root has no `onOpenChangeComplete`. A template ref of the root has `close()`. With `:css="false"`, the `leave` hook of a `<Transition>` keeps the popup until it calls `done`, so the root has no `unmount` action. A press on the link goes to its `href` and changes no card, so no change has the reason `trigger-press`.
The portal is a `<Teleport>` with no element of its own, so it has no `as` and no `element` slot. Put an element in the portal when you need one.

`<Transition>` around the backdrop animates it, so the state has no `transitionStatus`, and the backdrop has no `data-starting-style` and no `data-ending-style`. CSS selects a closed backdrop that stays in the DOM with `[hidden]`, so the backdrop has no `data-open` and no `data-closed`.

`<Transition>` around the popup animates it, so the state has no `transitionStatus`, and the popup has no `data-starting-style` and no `data-ending-style`. CSS selects a closed popup that stays in the DOM with `[hidden]`, so the popup has no `data-open` and no `data-closed`.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to register the link with its root, or a generated id when `id` is absent, so it is a declared prop. A handle opens the card for the link with this `id`. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the trigger, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
The portal is a `<Teleport>`, and `disabled` renders its content in place, also on the server.
The portal is a `<Teleport>`, and it takes the props of `<Teleport>`: `defer` waits for the other content of the update.
`v-model:trigger-id` binds the active trigger: Vue binds a second state of a component with a named `v-model`.

returnTypeDifferences.reason: `PreviewCard.Handle` is the class `PreviewCardHandle`. The declaration of the function names the class, and Base UI documents the same class by its name in the namespace.
